label: BDP565
source: doi: 10.1093/nar/gkaf511, additional data provided by Zimo Jin; GenBank file '1.2 BDP565.gb' supplied by the user (356 bp). Stored as in the file (5' end on the left, the GAL1-10 orientation: the right end faces the nanocompartment module).
notes: Bidirectional promoter. The GenBank file says: position 294, A to G, removes a BbsI recognition site (GAAGAC); the stored sequence is the corrected one. Checked: only A/C/G/T, no BsaI/BbsI site. The direction in which the two sides drive the modules still has to be checked against the lab.
